# Custom skills (Ring 3)

Your team's own skills live here as `<name>/SKILL.md`. The template **never overwrites this directory**.

- Match the shape of the skills in `.github/skills/` (frontmatter `name` + a `description` that says
  WHAT it does and **WHEN** to use it — "Use when…").
- Before relying on it, run it up the ladder in `ai/governance/how-to-eval-a-skill.md`.
- The `.github/ci-validators/validate-skills.js` gate checks the frontmatter on every PR.
